premises.text: Millions of Americans face a catch-22: they need credit history to get credit, leaving many unscored or subprime and paying costly financing
premises.evidence_span: in order to build or establish credit, first, you need credit. It's a fundamental catch-22

premises.text: Users make scheduled monthly payments that Self Lender reports to credit bureaus, then receive the saved balance back at term end
premises.evidence_span: Self Lender enables our users to build positive payment history, the most important factor in determining your credit score

premises.text: Signup is quick and low-cost with selectable monthly amounts and term lengths
premises.evidence_span: Signing up with Self Lender is easy, takes less than three minutes, and only costs $3 per month

premises.text: Payment performance data unlocks exclusive lending offers such as cheaper auto loans and one-click down-payment application of the Self Lender balance
premises.evidence_span: Self Lender uses her payment data internally to offer her exclusive lending opportunities

value.text: People build credit, save money, and gain access to affordable financial products
value.evidence_span: bill credit, save money, and gain access to affordable financial products

causal_links.evidence_span: Not having credit is expensive and very limiting
build positive payment history, the most important factor in determining your credit score
Self Lender uses her payment data internally to offer her exclusive lending opportunities

notes: Unscored/subprime prevalence and Dolores high-interest example folded as one catch-22 problem (§4.1.6). Credit-union model, bureau reporting, and balance-back mechanics folded as one credit-build product; $3 signup/amount/term choices as packaging of that product (§4.1.3, §4.1.7). Lifetime-savings market math treated as framing/traction, not a separate premise. Platform-of-choice vision treated as framing. Singleton D1/D3 retained.
